component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.rights.download
component.documentation: The download permission: the platform's DownloadService asks every permission before it streams a blob, and refuses the download with 403 when one returns false. This one asks the rights policies (org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.rights) about the document, the xpath and the rendition being downloaded. The script only hands them to AssetRightsDownloadPermission, which decides in Java. Should the class not load, the script answers false, so a broken install refuses downloads rather than serving them.
